name: Deore front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 117 g for the FD-MT62 normal-band clamp assembly fitting 28.0–28.6 mm seat tubes. The separate EC/endless-clamp options are not the weighed reference; the source does not identify the weighed chainguide variant.
